newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Elektrarny Opatovice sees CZK180 div.
newsitem.headline: Czech Elektrarny Opatovice sees CZK180 div.

text.p: Czech regional electricity utility Elektrarny Opatovice said on Tuesday it would probably propose a 180 crown gross dividend on 1996 profits at its annual general meeting on June 20.
"The dividend should be around last year's level of 180 crowns," Pavel Hypius of the company's finance department told Reuters.
A 180 crown gross divdend would imply distribution of around 40 percent of last year's net profit of 520 million crowns.
Hypius said the remainder would be undistributed or would go directly into company funds.
Elektrarny Opatovice's largest shareholders, according to figures at the beginning of June, are SPIF Cesky with 19 percent, IPF Komercni with 14 percent and Komercni Banka with nine percent.
